WITH stroke_ancestors AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (381316,443454,4310996,35609033,432923)
), stroke_conditions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id, co.visit_occurrence_id, co.condition_start_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
    JOIN stroke_ancestors sa ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = sa.concept_id
    WHERE co.visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL
), stroke_visits AS (
    SELECT v.person_id, v.visit_occurrence_id, v.visit_start_date, v.visit_end_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.person_id ORDER BY v.visit_start_date, v.visit_occurrence_id) AS rn
    FROM omop.visit_occurrence v
    JOIN stroke_conditions sc ON sc.visit_occurrence_id = v.visit_occurrence_id
    WHERE v.visit_concept_id IN (9201, 262)
), index_stroke AS (
    SELECT * FROM stroke_visits WHERE rn = 1
), outcomes AS (
    SELECT i.person_id, i.visit_occurrence_id, i.visit_start_date, i.visit_end_date,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM omop.visit_occurrence r
               WHERE r.person_id = i.person_id
                 AND r.visit_concept_id IN (9201, 262)
                 AND r.visit_occurrence_id <> i.visit_occurrence_id
                 AND r.visit_start_date > i.visit_end_date
                 AND r.visit_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 180, i.visit_end_date)
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS readmit_6mo
    FROM index_stroke i
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS index_stroke_patients,
       SUM(readmit_6mo) AS readmitted_6mo,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(readmit_6mo) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS pct_readmitted_6mo
FROM outcomes

                 AND r.visit_concept_id IN (9201, 262)
                 AND r.visit_occurrence_id <> i.visit_occurrence_id
                 AND r.visit_start_date > i.visit_end_date
                 AND r.visit_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 180, i.visit_end_date)
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS readmit_6mo
    FROM index_stroke i
), comorbidity_defs AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
      (316139, 'Heart failure'),
      (313217, 'Atrial fibrillation'),
      (46271022, 'Chronic kidney disease'),
      (4212540, 'Chronic liver disease'),
      (255848, 'Pneumonia'),
      (439777, 'Anemia'),
      (4182210, 'Dementia'),
      (380378, 'Epilepsy'),
      (440383, 'Depressive disorder'),
      (321052, 'Peripheral vascular disease'),
      (4329847, 'Myocardial infarction'),
      (443392, 'Malignant neoplastic disease'),
      (317576, 'Coronary arteriosclerosis'),
      (201820, 'Diabetes mellitus'),
      (316866, 'Hypertensive disorder'),
      (320128, 'Essential hypertension'),
      (433736, 'Obesity'),
      (432867, 'Hyperlipidemia')
    ) AS d(concept_id, comorbidity)
), patient_comorbidity AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id, d.comorbidity
    FROM outcomes o
    JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = o.person_id
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
    JOIN comorbidity_defs d ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = d.concept_id
    WHERE co.condition_start_date <= o.visit_start_date
), counts AS (
    SELECT d.comorbidity,
           SUM(CASE WHEN pc.person_id IS NOT NULL AND o.readmit_6mo=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS a_exposed_readmit,
           SUM(CASE WHEN pc.person_id IS NOT NULL AND o.readmit_6mo=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b_exposed_no_readmit,
           SUM(CASE WHEN pc.person_id IS NULL AND o.readmit_6mo=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_unexposed_readmit,
           SUM(CASE WHEN pc.person_id IS NULL AND o.readmit_6mo=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d_unexposed_no_readmit,
           SUM(CASE WHEN pc.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exposed_n,
           COUNT(*) AS total_n
    FROM comorbidity_defs d
    CROSS JOIN outcomes o
    LEFT JOIN patient_comorbidity pc ON pc.person_id=o.person_id AND pc.comorbidity=d.comorbidity
    GROUP BY d.comorbidity
)
SELECT TOP 18 comorbidity,
       exposed_n,
       a_exposed_readmit AS readmit_with_comorbidity,
       CAST(100.0*a_exposed_readmit/NULLIF(exposed_n,0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS readmit_pct_with,
       CAST(100.0*c_unexposed_readmit/NULLIF((total_n-exposed_n),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS readmit_pct_without,
       CAST((1.0*a_exposed_readmit*d_unexposed_no_readmit)/NULLIF((1.0*b_exposed_no_readmit*c_unexposed_readmit),0) AS decimal(10,2)) AS odds_ratio,
       CAST(EXP(LOG((1.0*a_exposed_readmit*d_unexposed_no_readmit)/NULLIF((1.0*b_exposed_no_readmit*c_unexposed_readmit),0)) - 1.96*SQRT(1.0/a_exposed_readmit + 1.0/b_exposed_no_readmit + 1.0/c_unexposed_readmit + 1.0/d_unexposed_no_readmit)) AS decimal(10,2)) AS ci95_low,
       CAST(EXP(LOG((1.0*a_exposed_readmit*d_unexposed_no_readmit)/NULLIF((1.0*b_exposed_no_readmit*c_unexposed_readmit),0)) + 1.96*SQRT(1.0/a_exposed_readmit + 1.0/b_exposed_no_readmit + 1.0/c_unexposed_readmit + 1.0/d_unexposed_no_readmit)) AS decimal(10,2)) AS ci95_high
FROM counts
WHERE exposed_n >= 100 AND a_exposed_readmit > 0 AND b_exposed_no_readmit > 0 AND c_unexposed_readmit > 0 AND d_unexposed_no_readmit > 0
ORDER BY odds_ratio DESC

content.text: Updated item #3
Updated item #4

Using OMOP EHR data, I defined:

- Index stroke: first inpatient/ER+inpatient visit with a stroke-related condition descendant of cerebrovascular accident, cerebral infarction, ischemic stroke, hemorrhagic stroke, or subarachnoid hemorrhage.
- Outcome: subsequent inpatient/ER+inpatient visit within 180 days after index stroke discharge.
- Cohort: 21,781 index stroke patients.
- 6-month readmission: 8,327 patients, 38.23%.

Strongest comorbidity associations by unadjusted odds ratio:

| Comorbidity | N with comorbidity | Readmit % with | Readmit % without | OR | 95% CI |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Anemia | 9,129 | 47.80% | 31.32% | 2.01 | 1.90–2.12 |
| Pneumonia | 4,136 | 48.26% | 35.88% | 1.67 | 1.56–1.78 |
| Peripheral vascular disease | 2,551 | 47.90% | 36.95% | 1.57 | 1.44–1.70 |
| Malignant neoplastic disease | 5,195 | 46.53% | 35.63% | 1.57 | 1.48–1.67 |
| Chronic kidney disease | 4,594 | 45.99% | 36.16% | 1.50 | 1.41–1.61 |
| Chronic liver disease | 1,815 | 47.11% | 37.42% | 1.49 | 1.35–1.64 |
| Epilepsy | 1,860 | 47.15% | 37.40% | 1.49 | 1.36–1.64 |
| Obesity | 2,732 | 46.45% | 37.05% | 1.47 | 1.36–1.60 |
| Heart failure | 5,068 | 44.24% | 36.41% | 1.39 | 1.30–1.48 |
| Depressive disorder | 3,874 | 43.75% | 37.04% | 1.32 | 1.23–1.42 |

Bottom line: the strongest signal was anemia, associated with about doubled odds of 6-month readmission after stroke. Other prominent associations were pneumonia, peripheral vascular disease, cancer, chronic kidney disease, chronic liver disease, epilepsy, obesity, and heart failure.

Caveat: these are unadjusted associations from diagnosis-history flags prior to index stroke, not causal or risk-adjusted estimates.
